## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Orlando, United States. It starts at 8441 International Drive, Suite 250.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Sorry sports fans, this is a different kind of Orlando magic. Get your Museum of Illusions Orlando tickets and make your brain fizz like a soda can strapped to a rollercoaster!
>
> Right on International Drive, the Museum of Illusions Orlando is home to more than 50 exhibits of mind-bending optical, photographic, and interactive illusions. Challenge your perceptions with a cerebral saunter that includes the vast Infinity Room, the topsy-turvy Reverse Room, and an Ames Room which will cut you down to size – literally!
